messages:
sara-cs: Hey team, OrbitPay reported degraded responses for APAC users after a failover this morning. They say outputs are truncated and tokenization looks off. Happened around 03:10 UTC.

maria-support: Customer pasted example: `Payment request: charge 1234 for $50` -> bot returns gibberish, missing fields. Also latency spiked from ~120ms to ~900ms. Billing note: they saw a burst of retries, doubled token usage.

tim-eng: I pulled the request id they sent (req_8b2f). Looks like our region router rerouted to eu-west backup due to a degraded host, and the backup served model variant `redwood-small-q4_0` instead of `redwood-std-v2`. That variant uses a different tokenizer profile.

olga-infra: Confirmed failover event in the routing logs: `route_decision: fallback_region=eu-west, variant=small-quantized`. Host had GPU OOM, autoscaler shifted.

maria-support: Customer also got 401 errors for a few retries. They believe auth was flaky during the window. Any correlation?

tim-eng: The 401s are from expired edge tokens — our auth cache had a short outage at same time (logged), some requests retried and hit fallback which had a different model. Combined effect = higher latency + different tokenizer -> malformed outputs.

infra-bot: deploybot: autoscale: removed host gpu-12 after OOM at 03:09:58 UTC. fallback route enabled to eu-west pool (variants: small-quantized, tiny-legacy).

olga-infra: Root cause chain seems: transient GPU OOM -> autoscale removed node -> router policy chose eu-west for capacity -> eu-west only had quantized small variants for that model family -> mismatch in tokenizer/vocab -> customer-visible quality drop.

sara-cs: OrbitPay is asking for repro steps and whether we can map which variant served which requests so they can correlate with their logs. Also they want assurance this won't silently swap again.

tim-eng: Actionable repro and artifacts: 1) Request id list from customer (they've shared a sample). 2) We can search request traces: `select * from traces where request_id in (...)` and filter by `served_variant`. 3) I'll attach the relevant trace links and a quick curl to reproduce against the eu-west fallback: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-std-v2","input":"Payment request: charge 1234 for $50"}'
```
Run from APAC sim (e.g., runbook has `--region ap-southeast-1` helper). If router decides eu-west, you should see the swapped variant.

maria-support: Suggested mitigation for customer: pin to `model_version: redwood-std-v2@sha:abc123` in their config (forces exact model). Also enable `no-fallback` policy for critical routes temporarily. We should advise about costs if autoscaling forces remote fallback.

olga-infra: Longer-term fixes: ensure region pools register compatible variant families, and add router constraint so fallback only picks variants with compatible tokenizer profiles. I'll open infra ticket.

tim-eng: I've already started a quick patch to include tokenizer fingerprint in the routing decision and to log `served_variant_tokenizer` in traces. Will roll a canary to staging.

maria-support: For OrbitPay: I told them we can: (a) provide the exact trace list + variant mapping, (b) offer a short credits adjustment for retry token spike, and (c) recommend pinning or disabling fallback for critical routes. They asked for ETA for a guard that prevents incompatible variant swaps.

olga-infra: ETA: canary tomorrow, full rollout early next week assuming no regressions. I'll add a postmortem note in #postmortems once the infra ticket is created.

sara-cs: Thanks. Can someone post the trace links here when available? I'll follow up with OrbitPay and include the repro steps and temporary workarounds. :thumbsup:

maria-support: Will do. Leaving a short summary for handoff: 1) Cause: GPU OOM -> fallback to eu-west small-quantized. 2) Impact: tokenizer/vocab drift + latency + auth retries -> malformed outputs and billing spike. 3) Mitigations: pin model/version, no-fallback policy, token credits offer. 4) Permanent: routing + tokenizer-fingerprint guard.
